criteria.rule: return / max drawdown >= BTC buy & hold's (same window)
beats >= 90% of 1,000 random weekly rotations among the same assets

survivorship_note: Survivorship bias: SOL and BNB were picked knowing they survived (and grew); coins that faded are not in the list, so these results may look better than reality.
limitations: Design data only (before 2025-10-29): evidence about the past, not validation.
